subject.title: [Feature]: Add live preview capabilities (draftPreview, previewFinalization) to Feishu message adapter

question: Should Feishu retain its existing Card Kit streaming path as the supported live-response experience, or should OpenClaw add a separate non-card live-preview contract for response shapes that cards do not cover?
rationale: Current documentation establishes real-time Feishu streaming as the default, but it does not establish that the Telegram-specific capability contract is required or compatible with Feishu’s card-based delivery model.

options.title: Require a concrete gap first
options.body: Keep the existing streaming-card path and request a current Feishu reproduction showing an output shape that cannot receive partial updates.

options.title: Sponsor non-card parity
options.body: Approve a scoped Feishu plugin design for non-card live previews, with explicit ownership of finalization and duplicate-delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Require a concrete gap first
recommendation.body: Keep the existing streaming-card path and request a current Feishu reproduction showing an output shape that cannot receive partial updates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release history connects this person to Feishu streaming-card behavior, though the attribution is indirect.
